commands:
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

git show 8f24ee03a43a937c4310d20d4149663aa6703d7b:lib/test/run-shard.sh > /tmp/rs.sh
for s in monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of "$s"; done | sort > /tmp/union.txt
echo "raw count: $(for s in monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of "$s"; done | grep -c .)"
echo "unique count: $(sort -u /tmp/union.txt | grep -c .)"
echo "dupes:"; sort /tmp/union.txt | uniq -d

git show 8f24ee03a43a937c4310d20d4149663aa6703d7b:lib/test/run-shard.sh > /tmp/rs.sh
for s in monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of "$s"; done | sort -o /tmp/union.txt
printf 'raw: '; for s in monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of "$s"; done | grep -c .
printf 'uniq: '; sort -u /tmp/union.txt | grep -c .
printf 'dupes: '; uniq -d /tmp/union.txt | tr '\n' ' '; echo

git show 8f24ee03a43a937c4310d20d4149663aa6703d7b:lib/test/run-shard.sh > /tmp/rs.sh
for s in monolith python-pool modules-pin modules-large modules-rest; do bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of $s; done | sort -o /tmp/union.txt
grep -c . /tmp/union.txt
sort -u /tmp/union.txt | grep -c .
uniq -d /tmp/union.txt

git show 8f24ee03a43a937c4310d20d4149663aa6703d7b:lib/test/run-shard.sh > /tmp/rs.sh
bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of modules-pin > /tmp/u.txt
bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of modules-large >> /tmp/u.txt
bash /tmp/rs.sh --modules-of modules-rest >> /tmp/u.txt
sort -o /tmp/u.txt /tmp/u.txt
grep -c . /tmp/u.txt
sort -u /tmp/u.txt | grep -c .
uniq -d /tmp/u.txt

bash /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/run-shard.sh --modules-of modules-pin; bash /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/run-shard.sh --modules-of modules-large; bash /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/run-shard.sh --modules-of modules-rest

bash /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/run-shard.sh --list-shards | while read s; do bash /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/run-shard.sh --modules-of "$s"; done | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
